column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister Denies Her Otaku Hobby
That Kirino... is she trying to completely deny her otaku hobbies... the hobbies she declared as being just as important to her as her best friend?
If that's what you're trying to do, then let me inform you carefully.
Firstly, "Love with Little Sister♪" and "Stardust ☆ Witch Meruru". It all started after I discovered these.
This is "Shin Imouto Taisen Siscalypse" (Showdown of the True Little Sisters). I was forced to play this against you because you always lose online.
You had a fight with Ayase due to this. Isn't that right?
Thanks to you, I'm still being treated as a criminal by Ayase.
Here's the absurdly thick reference companion book along with the delusional novel you got from Kuroneko.
Didn't you go mad with anger because the character in it modeled after you got treated badly?
Just how much damage do you think I sustained when I got stuck between you and Kuroneko back then?
Custom Imouto and "Onii-pantsu". Because you said you wanted to buy them, I went in line for it and missed the midnight train back home.
Looking back, all of them were bad memories...
Do... Do you think that such made-up stories will be able to deceive me...
Deceive... what are you saying?
Listen, I'll keep saying it as many times as it takes. You like little sister goods to the extent that you will put them to your face to smell them...
You love "little sisters" so much that you can't help it!!
Those are all the things that describe yourself! Pervert! Die!
Uwah! H-Hey!? Stop throwing the DVDs and figurines! They'll break!
I don't care about such things!
Ouch!?
W-Why aren't you avoiding them?
They'll break if I don't catch them! Stop!! Even if you're fooling around, you're overdoing it!
These are all your precious treasures! Have you forgotten, your "Stardust ☆ Witch Meruru"!
The scene where the main character Meruru uses her Meteor Impact to shatter her friends into tiny pieces, didn't you say that was your favorite!
What's with that senseless development!? That's impossible to believe!
How could I possibly like such things!
That's what I've thought in the beginning as well!
After all, no one would normally believe that in reality my little sister is well informed in little sister moe.
However, after spending time with you, Kuroneko and Saori, my prejudice immediately disappeared.
Everything is all thanks to you. It's all your fault!
You're saying it's me? That's impossible!
No, it IS you!
You're absolutely lying! They're yours, aren't they?
You really think they're mine?
Of course!
Ah, what should I do to make her believe me!?
For starters, there's no way things like this would exist in my bedroom.
H-Hey, what are you doing with the otaku goods you're carrying?
Huh? I'm obviously going to throw them out through the window.
Y-You idiot!
That hurts! Don't touch me, you pervert!!
You.... Do you even know what you're trying to do!?
Huh? If these things are mine, I can do whatever I want with them, right?!
Look! Isn't this your favorite Meruru! I still have the message you sent me requesting it as proof!
...You're quite persistent.
You! What are you...
Hmph, such things! Of course they're going right into the garbage bin!
W-W-What are you doing!?
Since it's a souvenir you got for me, I can do whatever I want with it, right?
Furthermore, fabricating a mail that I sent you, that's unfathomable even for you.
You... siscon!
?! Why you...!
Finally, I had to ride an anime-decorated bicycle back home from Akihabara. Furthermore, I was forced by my little sister to play the game together
with her till morning!
